# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser canvas game titled **Aftershift Zombie Shooter: Neo Horde Poggers**. Preserve the source mechanic truth: menu mode selection, scope-drag aim-and-fire mode, joystick survival-run mode, ammo/signal pressure, target/alpha elimination, exit or win state, loss state, restart/menu flow, and one-thumb mobile actionability. Transform the presentation into Zombie Shooter. A satirical game inspired by Akira built around zombie shooter play, with competitive, futuristic, leaderboard energy, after work session design, search-friendly hooks like zombie shooter, shooter, survival, aesthetics like neon noir, shonen aesthetic, neon aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as chad, poggers. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range. The focal actor is a neon courier survivor; enemies are procedural zombie salarymen and hulking infected; the target is an alpha zombie; the city is a procedural neon-noir quarantine corridor with shonen speed lines, leaderboard overlays, toxic green rot, magenta/cyan lighting, meme-tone feedback, and readable mobile HUD.

# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a self-contained canvas shooter with menu, mode choice, active play, win/loss overlays, retry/menu paths, and one-thumb controls. Sniper mode drags the camera/reticle and taps FIRE to run target hit detection. Run mode uses a touch joystick, limited ammo, signal/cover depletion, guard aggression, and an exit objective after target elimination.

## Protected mechanics
Input semantics, update loop cadence, camera drag, joystick movement, FIRE action, reticle/proximity hit checks, ammo decrement, signal failure, target kill success, guard contact loss, panic particles, mode selection, and restart flow are preserved.

## Remix target
Rebuild the public surface as **Aftershift Zombie Shooter: Neo Horde Poggers**, a portrait-first neon-noir zombie shooter where a tired courier clocks out into a competitive quarantine leaderboard. The focal actor, horde hazards, alpha target, HUD, procedural city, and feedback all use the same satirical futuristic zombie-survival vocabulary.
